answer: A fresh clone wakes at dawn on a bare terrace holding no lantern of its own: no trail of sealed, quorum-matched grading verdicts behind its key. Standing is lit only by on-ledger judgments other graders re-check against consensus, so it cannot be minted, bought, or handed to a sibling key. A thousand fakes must each grade their own way up across many epochs, and the attacker pays that honest-judgment labor once per identity. The Sybil bill therefore scales linearly with the clone count and never amortizes.
